svg.text: Solid = proses (uap / air) Dashed = sinyal instrumen ⬡ = sistem luar / logika
URUTAN PROSES: Kondensat → Deaerator → BFP → Economizer (pemanas awal air) → Steam Drum
→ Evaporator/Riser → Drum → Superheater → Main Steam → MSV/GV → Turbin → Generator; uap
bekas → Kondensor (pendingin dari Cooling Tower) → kembali ke Deaerator.
KONTROL: LIC-01 level drum → FCV-01 air pengisi; TIC-01 suhu uap keluar superheater →
PROTEKSI: LSLL/LSHH drum → Boiler Trip (MFT); TURBINE TRIP → MSV-01 menutup (fail
close); PSV-01 melepas uap lebih ke Silencer.
